annotations.title: Validate a business tax ID (any supported country)

description: Validate a business tax or registry ID for any supported country with the deepest check available for it. Norway (organisation number), Finland (Y-tunnus or VAT), France (SIREN, SIRET or VAT), Ireland (CRO company number) and Taiwan (unified business number) are checked live against the official open registry: legal name, status (active, dissolved, bankrupt, struck off and others), address, key dates, the source with its licence and the date of the data, verification_level "official_registry" and a pass/review/fail assessment with reasons. Ireland comes from the CRO daily snapshot, not a live query. Dominican Republic RNC (9 digits) is checked against our copy of the DGII RNC registry file, refreshed from the file the DGII publishes daily (legal and trade name, status, activity, payment regime); an 11-digit cédula of a natural person gets the format check only, without any name. Chile RUT is checked against our copy of the SII register of legal entities (nómina de personas jurídicas, refreshed a few times a year: see source.data_as_of): name, legal form, start date and término de giro (closure = fail). Canada BN (9 digits, or with a program account such as RT0001) is checked against our copy of the Corporations Canada federal corporations data, refreshed daily (Open Government Licence – Canada): name, status, registered office, dates; it covers federal corporations only, so a BN not found is review, never fail. For sole proprietorships (Norway ENK, French entrepreneurs individuels, Finnish sole traders) only the status is returned, without name or address. EU VAT numbers of 24 member states (all but Finland, France and Ireland, which have the registries above) are checked live in VIES, the VAT Information Exchange System of the European Commission: pass = the VAT number is registered for intra-EU transactions today, fail = it is not. VIES is not the trade register, so a valid VAT number does not show that the company is solvent or still registered; the name VIES returns is given only to API-key holders, and Germany and Spain share no name (legal_name null). Czechia (ARES), Latvia (Enterprise Register) and Romania (ANAF) add the legal name and status from the national register, and the company number (id_type "ico") is checked in ARES for Czechia and RPO for Slovakia. Switzerland UID (UID register, live), Israel company number (Companies Register dataset, daily) and Singapore UEN (ACRA dataset, refreshed monthly) are official-registry checks too. United Kingdom company numbers (id_type "crn") are checked live against the Companies House register (name, status, type, incorporation date, registered office; dissolved = fail, liquidation or administration = review); a UK VAT number gets the format check only. If VIES or a register does not answer, the tool returns an error and the call is not billed. Peru, Mexico, Colombia and Costa Rica are answered by the same lookups as their own tools. Every other covered country (including the United States, Brazil, Australia, India and Japan) gets the offline format check with verification_level "format", which never returns pass.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "NO", "FI", "FR", "IE", "TW", "DO", "CL", "CA", "DE", "IT", "CH", "SG", "GB", "PE". "EL" is accepted for Greece and "UK" for the United Kingdom.

id.description: The ID as written, with or without the country prefix, spaces, dots or dashes, e.g. "974761076", "1003521-5", "FR90130004955", "98788", "03741302".

id_type.description: Optional ID type when the country has several, e.g. "siren", "siret", "vat", "ytunnus", "cro", "orgnr", "ubn", "rnc", "cedula", "rut", "bn", "ico", "uid", "uen", "crn". Detected from the input when omitted.
